review.notes:
1. Screen recording: attached. Captured on a physical iPhone SE (2nd generation), from app launch through the core flow: tapping out an acid pattern on a 303, programming a beat on the 808 and 909, riding cutoff and resonance while the pattern plays, and the master filter / bitcrush section.

2. Devices and OS tested: iPhone SE (2nd generation) running iOS 15.4.1. The app was installed and run on that device from a Release build. The app's deployment target is iOS 15.0.

3. Purpose and target audience: Tiny Acid Jam is a pocket acid-house groovebox. Two 303-style bass synths with a diode-ladder filter, slides, accents and ties, plus an 808 and a 909 drum machine, all locked to one shared transport, with a master filter, bitcrush and gate section. It is for anyone who wants to program acid and house patterns without hardware or a DAW. It runs entirely offline.

4. Setup and access: no account, login or credentials are required. The app opens straight into the groovebox with a pattern already loaded, so there is nothing to set up. It is a one-time paid app with no in-app purchases, and no sample files are needed to test it.

5. External services: none. Tiny Acid Jam is fully native and offline. It uses no data providers, authentication services, payment processors or AI services, and contains no analytics or tracking. All sound is synthesized on the device; the app ships no audio recordings.

6. Regional differences: none. The app functions identically in all regions.

7. Regulated industry or protected material: not applicable. All sounds and content are original and synthesized.

Additional note: the app also installs an Audio Unit v3 instrument extension ("Mipolai: Tiny Acid Jam"), so the same rack can be loaded as a plug-in inside a host such as GarageBand on the same device.

listing.title: Tiny Acid Jam: 303 Groovebox
listing.subtitle: 808, 909, house in your pocket
listing.promotionalText: Two 303s, an 808 and a 909 in your pocket. Tap out a squelchy acid line, program a beat, ride the filter for the drop. The whole rack, no cables, no nonsense.
listing.description:
Cut & resonance, you know you want it.

A pocket acid house machine, for you never know when.

Two 303-style bass synths, a booming 808 and a housey 909, all locked to the one transport. Squelchy acid line (using the real diode-ladder filter), glides, accents, ties, the whole lot. And the Devil Fish mod you can turn on and off.

Program beats on the 808 and/or the 909, swing, distortion, reverb sends. And in the master panel you can do extra filtering, the PCF, or bitcrush and gate.

No mic, no gear, no accounts. The whole groovebox is in the app.

Made by one person who wanted an acid box to mess about with on the couch. No ads, no tracking. You buy it, you own it.

iap.//: ADR-0035: the app is FREE; one non-consumable Pro unlock buys the paths that carry audio OUT of the app (WAV export, MIDI in/out, the AUv3 extension). `unlocks` is EMPTY on purpose: it names CART slugs and Pro gates no rack, so build-app.js leaves the (only) rack free and finds no master pass.
